title: A Token-Incentivized Mental Health Ecosystem Using DID

ms.promise:
Figma Prototype covering complete user journey with the following key functions:
・Anonymous Account Creation: User onboarding flow with SSI wallet generation and DID establishment without identity disclosure
・Anonymous KYC Verification: Reusable identity verification system using DID technology that maintains anonymity while confirming eligibility
・Mental Health Questionnaire and Referral: Comprehensive screening assessment with intelligent referral system based on risk factors and user preferences
・Verifiable Credential Issuance: Professional assessment integration where mental health providers can issue treatment need certificates as verifiable credentials to user DIDs
・Research and Opportunity Platform: Organization dashboard for posting research studies and support opportunities, with anonymous user participation and token reward mechanisms
ms.criteria:
・Prototype Completeness: All five core functions are fully designed and interactive in Figma with realistic user flows
・Anonymous Flow Verification: User journey demonstrates complete anonymity preservation from account creation through research participation
